title: Maximum Erasure Value
description:
Choose one nonempty contiguous subarray whose elements are all distinct. Its score is the sum of its elements. Return the maximum score.

## Examples

```text
Input: nums = [4,2,4,5,6]
Output: 17
```

```text
Input: nums = [5,2,1,2,5,2,1,2,5]
Output: 8
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= nums.length <= 10^5`
- `1 <= nums[i] <= 10^4`
